verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS docs platform with a CLI, so the axis applies. The pack documents an analytics dashboard that measures traffic and usage, and a self-hosting option, but nothing describes a setting, flag, or config to disable telemetry or usage tracking. Self-hosting is an adjacent deployment choice, not an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
